output.interpretation: The request names only a disease ("pancreatic cancer") and gives no comparison, so it can't yet be framed as a two-group test. The most likely default is pancreatic cancer (PDAC) tumor tissue (case) vs. non-tumor pancreas tissue (control). However, many other comparisons are just as plausible, such as subtype vs. subtype, drug-treated vs. untreated, or gene knockdown vs. control in PDAC lines. Each of these leads to a different set of GEO series and samples.

output.interpretation: Patient-derived pancreatic cancer organoids (mostly PDAC) treated with a drug in culture (case) compared with the same organoid lines left untreated or given vehicle such as DMSO (control). Both arms must come from the same human bulk RNA-seq GEO series with NCBI raw counts and at least 3 samples per arm. Cell lines, xenografts, primary tumours and engineered or stem-cell-derived organoids are excluded.
